{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for QA orders: they have revenue = '999,999.99' (with comma)
# The previous check used '999999.99' — this is wrong
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print("QA orders found (with comma):", len(qa_orders))

# Now filter completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if any QA orders are in completed orders
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print("QA orders in completed orders:", len(qa_in_completed))

# Compute mean revenue after removing QA orders
# But only if they are in the completed set
if len(qa_in_completed) > 0:
    # Remove them
    clean_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != '999,999.99']
    clean_completed['revenue_numeric'] = clean_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    mean_revenue = clean_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()
    n_completed_clean = len(clean_completed)
else:
    mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()
    n_completed_clean = len(completed_orders)

# Print results
print("Number of completed orders (after QA removal if any):", n_completed_clean)
print("Mean revenue (after QA removal if any):", mean_revenue)"}
